title: maDMP rules file
description: The format of one rules/*.json file: a 'standard' declaration plus a recursive tree of DMP fields. Two orthogonal facts per field: '_cardinality' says how many values ('1' and '0..1' single, '1..n' and '0..n' list), '_type' says what each value is ('object' for structured entities, otherwise a scalar format). There is no 'list' type, list-ness is expressed by the cardinality alone. Five further coherence rules are not expressed here: only '_type: object' fields may declare child fields, every '_type: object' field must declare at least one, '_allowed_values'/'_suggested_values' may only appear on scalar fields, the two may never appear together on one field, and '_chapter_description' may only appear on a top-level object field.

standard.description: Identifier of the standard this file defines, snake_case (e.g. 'rda_dcs'), and the name of the directory this file sits in.

version.description: Version of this standard. Must equal the file's own name: rules/standards/<standard>/<version>.json.

extends.description: false for the single base standard, true for every extension.

description.description: Free-form notes about this file's scope and conventions.

dmp.description: The root of the field tree, every key is a top-level DMP field. At least one.

_cardinality.description: How many values: '1' exactly one, '0..1' at most one, '1..n' at least one, '0..n' any number. 'n' means the field holds a JSON array.

_type.description: What each value is: 'object' for a structured entity with child fields, at least one, otherwise the scalar's expected format.

_chapter_description.description: Description of the DSW chapter generated for a top-level object field, the only place it is valid.

_allowed_values.description: Closed vocabulary: a value outside this list is a violation of the standard. Never together with '_suggested_values' on the same field.

_suggested_values.description: Recommended vocabulary: a value outside this list is only worth a warning. Never together with '_allowed_values' on the same field.
